WITH 
CustomerAccountLimit
AS(
      SELECT * FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountLimit] A
      --JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID,LIMITTYPEID, MAX(TIMESTAMP) TIMESTAMP, FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SOURCESYSTEMCODE FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountLimit] WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' GROUP BY CUSTOMERACCOUNTID,LIMITTYPEID, FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SOURCESYSTEMCODE) B
      --  ON A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = B.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND A.LIMITTYPEID = B.LIMITTYPEID AND A.TIMESTAMP = B.TIMESTAMP AND A.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = B.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND A.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = B.SOURCESYSTEMCODE
      WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.TIMESTAMP,112) = '20231204'
      AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'  
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactCardsCreditLimit
(
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,PermanentCreditLimit
,CurrentCreditLimit
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,SUM(PermanentCreditLimit) PermanentCreditLimit
,SUM(CurrentCreditLimit) CurrentCreditLimit
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM (
SELECT 
  CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCL.TIMESTAMP,112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
,CASE WHEN BCL.LimitTypeId = 'Permanent Credit Limit' THEN ISNULL(LimitAmount,0)  ELSE NULL END AS PermanentCreditLimit
,CASE WHEN BCL.LimitTypeId = 'Credit Limit' THEN ISNULL(LimitAmount,0)  ELSE NULL END AS CurrentCreditLimit
,BCL.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm                                                                                          
FROM 
CustomerAccountLimit BCL
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BCL.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccountPaymentCard] BCP ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = BCP.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[PaymentCard] BPC ON BPC.PaymentCardId = BCP.PaymentCardId
WHERE DDA.AccountId IS NOT NULL

) A
GROUP BY
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm

WITH 
PaymentCardStatementSummary
AS(
      SELECT * FROM [BNKM].[PaymentCardStatementSummary] A
      WHERE convert(varchar,a.PeriodStartDate,112) = '20231204'
      AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'  
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance
(
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,StatementBalanceRetailAmount
,StatementBalanceCashAmount
,StatementBalance
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
 convert(varchar,BPCS.PeriodStartDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountID AS AccountID
,BPCS.RetailStatementBalanceAmount AS StatementBalanceRetailAmount
,BPCS.CashStatementBalanceAmount AS StatementBalanceCashAmount
,BPCS.RetailStatementBalanceAmount + BPCS.CashStatementBalanceAmount AS StatementBalance
,BPCS.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
PaymentCardStatementSummary BPCS
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BPCS.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BPCS.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BPCS.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1

INSERT INTO DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure
(
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,OutstandingBalanceAmount
,OutstandingInstallmentAmount
,RelationshipExposure
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)



SELECT 
convert(varchar,BPCS.PeriodStartDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountID
,BPCS.TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount AS OutstandingBalanceAmount
,BPCS.OutstandingInstallmentAmount AS OutstandingInstallmentAmount
,SUM(Case WHEN TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount > 0 THEN TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount ELSE 0 END + 
    CASE WHEN OutstandingInstallmentAmount > 0 THEN OutstandingInstallmentAmount ELSE 0 END ) RelationshipExposure
,BPCS.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
[BNKM].[PaymentCardStatementSummary]  BPCS
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BPCS.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BPCS.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BPCS.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE convert(varchar,BPCS.PeriodStartDate,112) = '20231204'

--GET LNS_Sanction_Limit_Amount FROM CustomerAccountLimit--
WITH 
CustomerAccountLimit
AS(
      SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit
      WHERE LimitTypeId = 'Sanction Limit Amount' 
      AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
      AND convert(varchar,Timestamp,112) = '20231204'
)
,
--GET ShareIndicator FROM DimCustomerAccount--
CNT_DCA AS (
SELECT AccountID,
CASE 
    WHEN COUNT(ShareIndicator) = NULL THEN 1
    WHEN COUNT(ShareIndicator) = 0 THEN 1
    ELSE COUNT(ShareIndicator)
    END AS CNT
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount 
WHERE ShareIndicator = 'Y'
GROUP BY AccountID
)

--INSERT--
INSERT INTO DW.FactLoansCreditLimit (
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,CreditLimitAmountFull_Original
,CreditLimitAmountProrated_Original
,Currency_Original
,Currency_Target
,PesoConversionRate
,CreditLimitAmountFull
,CreditLimitAmountProrated
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

--SELECT--
SELECT
CONVERT(VARCHAR, BCAL.Timestamp,112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountID AS AccountID
,BCAL.LimitAmount AS CreditLimitAmountFull_Original
,CONVERT(numeric(18,5), BCAL.LimitAmount / DCA.CNT) AS CreditLimitAmountProrated_Original
,BCAL.IsoCurrencyCode AS Currency_Original
,'PHP' AS Currency_Target
,BCC.ConversionRate AS PesoConversionRate
,CASE 
    WHEN BCAL.IsoCurrencyCode != 'PHP' 
    THEN BCAL.LimitAmount * BCC.ConversionRate
    ELSE BCAL.LimitAmount
END AS CreditLimitAmountFull
,CASE 
    WHEN BCAL.IsoCurrencyCode != 'PHP' 
    THEN BCAL.LimitAmount * BCC.ConversionRate
    ELSE CONVERT(numeric(18,5), BCAL.LimitAmount / DCA.CNT)
END AS CreditLimitAmountProrated
,BCAL.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM CustomerAccountLimit BCAL
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAL.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON DDB.BranchID = BCA.BranchId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDBK ON DDBK.BankID = BCAL.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON DDA.AccountID = BCAL.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN CNT_DCA DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BCAL.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates BCC ON BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId = BCAL.IsoCurrencyCode
AND BCC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAL.FinancialInstitutionId
AND BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = CONVERT(DATE, BCAL.Timestamp,112)
WHERE DDB.BranchSK IS NOT NULL
AND DDBK.BankSK IS NOT NULL
AND DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL
AND DDA.AccountID IS NOT NULL

WITH CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,CNT_DCA
AS
(
select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid

)

INSERT INTO  DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance
(
     BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AmortizationAmount
    ,InterestAmount
    ,PenaltyAmount
    ,OutstandingBalanceFull
    ,OutstandingBalanceProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,BRPP.AccountId
,SUM(AmortizationAmount) AS AmortizationAmount
,SUM(InterestAmount) AS InterestAmount
,SUM(PenaltyAmount) AS PenaltyAmount
,SUM(AmortizationAmount) + SUM(InterestAmount) + SUM(PenaltyAmount) AS OutstandingBalanceFull
,(SUM(AmortizationAmount) + SUM(InterestAmount) + SUM(PenaltyAmount) ) / DCA.CNT  AS OutstandingBalanceProrated
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM (
         SELECT
         CONVERT(VARCHAR,BRPP.DemandEffectiveDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
        ,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
        ,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
        ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
        ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
        ,CASE WHEN BRPP.DemandFlowId = 'PRDEM' THEN 
              CASE WHEN BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BRPP.DemandAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BRPP.DemandAmount END
         ELSE 0 END AS AmortizationAmount
        ,CASE WHEN BRPP.DemandFlowId = 'INDEM' THEN 
              CASE WHEN BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BRPP.DemandAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BRPP.DemandAmount END  
         ELSE 0 END AS InterestAmount
        ,CASE WHEN BRPP.DemandFlowId = 'APDEM' THEN 
              CASE WHEN BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BRPP.DemandAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BRPP.DemandAmount END
         ELSE 0 END AS PenaltyAmount
        FROM 
        [BNKM].[RepaymentPlanPayment] BRPP
        LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BRPP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
        LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
        LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BRPP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
        LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BRPP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
        LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BRPP.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BRPP.DemandDate = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
        where CONVERT(VARCHAR,BRPP.DemandEffectiveDate,112) = '20231204'
) BRPP
LEFT JOIN CNT_DCA DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BRPP.AccountId 

GROUP BY 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,BRPP.AccountId
,DCA.CNT

WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS(
    SELECT CustomerAccountId,PeriodEndDate,BalanceAmount,IsoCurrencyCode,FinancialInstitutionId,PeriodStartDate,SourceSystemCode
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance  WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Value Date'  AND '20231204' BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODSTARTDATE,112) AND ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112),'20991231')
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId,PeriodEndDate,BalanceAmount,IsoCurrencyCode,FinancialInstitutionId,PeriodStartDate,SourceSystemCode
)
, CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
, CNT_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory
AS
(
select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid


)

INSERT INTO DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure (
    BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,BalanceAmount
    ,TotalRelationshipExposureFull
    ,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)

 SELECT
 '20231204' AS BusinessDateSK
 ,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
 ,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
 ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
 ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
 ,BCAB.BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
 ,CASE WHEN BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BCAB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BCAB.BalanceAmount End AS TotalRelationshipExposureFull
 ,CASE WHEN BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BCAB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate) / DCA.CNT ELSE BCAB.BalanceAmount / DCA.CNT END AS TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
 ,BCAB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
 ,0 AS WorkFlowId
 ,0 AS TaskRunId
 ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
 FROM 
 CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCAB
 LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAB.CustomerAccountId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.CustomerAccountId)
 LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1 
 LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDBK ON BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
 LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID  AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
 LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND '20231204' = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
 LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BCAB.CustomerAccountId

WITH Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
    select AccountID,
    count(ShareIndicator) as CNT
    from DW.DimCustomerAccount where ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    group by AccountID
)

INSERT INTO  DW.FactSecurityPortfolio
(
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSk
,AccountID
,PortfolioEndValueFull
,PortfolioEndValueProrated
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm

)

SELECT 
convert(varchar,BCASP.[DATESTAMP],112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BRANCHSK AS BranchSK
,DDBANK.BANKSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSk
,DDA.AccountID AS AccountID
,SUM(BCASP.EndValue) AS PortfolioEndValueFull
,SUM(BCASP.EndValue)/ DCA.CNT AS PortfolioEndValueProrated
,BCASP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio BCASP
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT BCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCASP.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBRANCH DDB ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDB.BRANCHID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DDBANK ON BCASP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBANK.BankId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCASP.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = DDA.ACCOUNTID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BCASP.CustomerAccountId
WHERE convert(varchar,BCASP.[DATESTAMP],112) = '20231204'
GROUP BY 
 convert(varchar,BCASP.[DATESTAMP],112)
,DDB.BRANCHSK
,DDBANK.BANKSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountID
,BCASP.SourceSystemCode
,DCA.CNT

WITH CustomerAccountBalance
AS(

SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance WHERE BalanceTypeId IN ('Fixed Income Product Outstanding', 
'Money Market Product Outstanding', 'Structured Product PYA Outstanding', 'Structured Product Asset Swap')
AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' AND IsoCurrencyCode = 'PHP'

)
, CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
    select AccountID,
    count(ShareIndicator) as CNT
    from DW.DimCustomerAccount where ShareIndicator = 'Y'
    group by AccountID
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment
( 
 BusinessDateSK 
,BranchSK 
,BankSK 
,AccountSK 
,AccountID 
,OutstandingInvestmentFull 
,OutstandingInvestmentProrated 
,Currency 
,SourceSystemCode 
,WorkFlowId 
,TaskRunId 
,InsertDttm                                           
)


SELECT
convert(varchar,BCAB.[Timestamp],112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBANK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountID
,SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount) AS OutstandingInvestmentFull
,SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount / CNT) AS OutstandingInvestmentProrated
,BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode AS Currency
,BCAB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId 
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM CustomerAccountBalance BCAB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT BCA ON BCAB.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCAB.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDB.BRANCHID aND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DDBANK ON BCAB.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDBANK.BANKID
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP ON BCAB.CustomerAccountId = BCAP.AccountId --join for count
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAB.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = DDA.ACCOUNTID AND BCAB.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE convert(varchar,BCAB.[Timestamp],112) = '20231204'
GROUP BY 
BCAB.[Timestamp]
,DDB.BranchSK
,DDBANK.BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId
,BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode
,BCAB.SourceSystemCode

WITH CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
SELECT BUB.CustomerAccountId,  COUNT(InternalCustomerId) CNT FROM [BNKM].[UITFAUMBalance] BUB
LEFT JOIN (SELECT InternalCustomerId,BaseAccountId FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedBaseAccount) BCRB ON BUB.BaseAccountId = BCRB.BaseAccountId
GROUP BY BUB.CustomerAccountId 
)

, DW_FACTTRUSTFUNDVALUE AS (

-- UITF --
SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BUB.BalanceTimestamp,112) AS BusinessDateSK
 ,-1 AS BranchSK
 ,DDK.BankSK AS BankSK
 ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
 ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
 ,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount AS AUMAmountFull
 ,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount/ISNULL(NULLIF(CAP.CNT,''),1)   AS AUMAmountProrated
 ,BUB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
 ,0 AS WorkFlowId
 ,0 AS TaskRunId
 ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
from [BNKM].[UITFAUMBalance] BUB
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA	ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDK 	ON BUB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA		ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation CAP ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = CAP.CustomerAccountId
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY 
BUB.BalanceTimestamp
,DDK.BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId
,BUB.TotalBalanceAmount
,CAP.CNT
,BUB.SourceSystemCode


UNION ALL


-- NonUITF --
SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BUB.BalanceTimestamp,112) AS BusinessDateSK
 ,-1 AS BranchSK
 ,DDK.BankSK AS BankSK
 ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
 ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
 ,BUB.BalanceAmount AS AUMAmountFull
 ,BUB.BalanceAmount/ISNULL(NULLIF(CAP.CNT,''),1)  AS AUMAmountProrated
 ,BUB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
 ,0 AS WorkFlowId
 ,0 AS TaskRunId
 ,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM [BNKM].[NonUITFAUMBalance] BUB
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA	ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDK 	ON BUB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA		ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation CAP ON BUB.CustomerAccountId = CAP.CustomerAccountId
WHERE DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY 
 BUB.BalanceTimestamp
,DDK.BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId
,BUB.BalanceAmount
,CAP.CNT
,BUB.SourceSystemCode
)

 BusinessDateSK

 ,AccountSK

 ,InsertDttm

SELECT [BusinessDateSK], DFAD.[BranchSK], DFAD.[BankSK], DFAD.[AccountSK], DFAD.[AccountID], [AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull], [AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated]

FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment WHERE BusinessDateSK = '20231204' ) 

INSERT INTO DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance
(
 [BusinessDateSK]
,[BranchSK]
,[BankSK]
,[CustomerSK]
,[CustomerID]
,[FullMarketSegmentSK]
,[ProratedMarketSegmentSK]
,[TotalRelationshipBalanceFull]
,[TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm]
)
SELECT 
 TRB.[BusinessDateSK]
,TRB.[BranchSK]
,TRB.[BankSK]
,TRB.CustomerSK
,TRB.CustomerID
,CASE WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TRB.TRBAmountFull >= 10000000 THEN 7     
      WHEN DMSF.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TRB.TRBAmountFull < 1 THEN 1 ELSE DMSF.MarketSegmentSK END AS FullMarketSegmentSK
,CASE WHEN DMSP.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TRB.TRBAmountProrated >= 10000000 THEN 7 
      WHEN DMSP.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND TRB.TRBAmountProrated < 1 THEN 1 ELSE DMSP.MarketSegmentSK END AS ProratedMarketSegmentSK
,TRB.TRBAmountFull
,TRB.TRBAmountProrated 
,TRB.SourceSystemCode
,TRB.WorkFlowId
,TRB.TaskRunId
,TRB.InsertDttm
FROM
 (
        SELECT 
          TRB.[BusinessDateSK]
        , NULL [BranchSK]
        , TRB.[BankSK]
        , DCA.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
        , DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
        , SUM([AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull]) AS TRBAmountFull
        , SUM([AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated]) AS TRBAmountProrated 
        , DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
        , 0 AS WorkFlowId
        , 0 AS TaskRunId
        , Getdate() AS InsertDttm
        FROM TRB
        LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON TRB.AccountSK = DCA.AccountSK
        LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
        WHERE DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
        GROUP BY 
         TRB.[BusinessDateSK]
        ,TRB.[BankSK]
        ,DCA.CustomerSK
        ,DCA.CustomerID
        ,DC.SourceSystemCode
) TRB
LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMSF ON ISNULL(TRB.TRBAmountFull,0) >= DMSF.LowerLimit AND ISNULL(TRB.TRBAmountFull,0) < DMSF.UpperLimit
LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMSP ON ISNULL(TRB.TRBAmountProrated,0) >= DMSP.LowerLimit AND ISNULL(TRB.TRBAmountProrated,0) < DMSP.UpperLimit
WHERE TRB.CustomerSK IS NOT NULL

WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'Average Current Balance'
    AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND '20231204' BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODSTARTDATE,112) AND ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112),'20991231')
)
, CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,
Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
    SELECT BCB.CustomerAccountId, COUNT(1) CNT FROM CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCB
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID 
    and DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY BCB.CustomerAccountId

)

INSERT INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD
(
     BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
@Businessdate AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount END  AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  
    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount / ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  
    END AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCPB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialProductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount  BCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDBK ON BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND '20231204' = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.CustomerAccountId 
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
 AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')

WITH CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' 
),
 CasaTdAggregateBalance
AS(
    SELECT * FROM [BNKM].[CasaTdAggregateBalance] WHERE AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112) = '20231204'
    
)
,
Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
    SELECT BCB.CustomerAccountId, COUNT(1) CNT FROM CasaTdAggregateBalance BCB
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID 
    and DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY BCB.CustomerAccountId

)

INSERT INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD
(
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)
SELECT 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BCB.AccumulatedCurrentBalance * BCC.ConversionRate) / DDD.DayOfYear
    ELSE BCB.AccumulatedCurrentBalance / DDD.DayOfYear END  AS AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull

,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN ( (BCB.ACCUMULATEDCURRENTBALANCE * BCC.ConversionRate )/ ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  ) / DDD.DayOfYear
    ELSE (BCB.ACCUMULATEDCURRENTBALANCE / ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  ) / DDD.DayOfYear
    END AS AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
,BCB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CasaTdAggregateBalance BCB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCB.CustomerAccountid = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialproductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion BCC ON BCA.IsoCurrencyCode = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCB.FinancialInstitutionId = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND  CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112) = BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON convert(varchar,BCA.BranchId) = DDB.BranchID  AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1 
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON convert(varchar,BCB.FinancialInstitutionId) = convert(varchar,DDBK.BankID)
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON convert(varchar,BCB.CustomerAccountId) = convert(varchar,DDA.AccountID) AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMDATE DDD ON  CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCB.PERIODENDDATE,112) = DDD.DateSK
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA','SBA','TDA')
AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112) = '20231204'

WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'
    AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND '20231204' BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODSTARTDATE,112) AND ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112),'20991231')
)
, CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,
CNT_DCA
AS
(
select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid

)

INSERT INTO DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
(
     BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,BalanceAmountFull
    ,BalanceAmountProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
'20231204' AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount END  AS BalanceAmountFull
,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  
    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount / ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  
    END AS BalanceAmountProrated
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCPB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialProductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDBK ON BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND '20231204' = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN CNT_DCA DCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountId
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%') 
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')

WITH TRE AS (
SELECT [BusinessDateSK], DFLR.[BranchSK], DFLR.[BankSK], DFLR.[AccountSK], DFLR.[AccountID], ABS([TotalRelationshipExposureFull]) as TotalRelationshipExposureFull, ABS([TotalRelationshipExposureProrated]) as TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
FROM dw.FactLoansRelationshipExposure DFLR
JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON DFLR.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK AND DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS'
WHERE DDA.AccountStatus not in ('Closed') AND DFLR.[BusinessDateSK] = '20231204'

UNION ALL

SELECT [BusinessDateSK], DFCR.[BranchSK], DFCR.[BankSK], DFCR.[AccountSK], DFCR.[AccountID], [RelationshipExposure], [RelationshipExposure] 
FROM dw.FactCardsRelationshipExposure DFCR
JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON DFCR.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK AND DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'CCD'
WHERE DDA.AccountStatus not in ('8') AND DFCR.[BusinessDateSK] = '20231204'
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure
(
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,TotalRelationshipExposureFull
,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
  TRE.[BusinessDateSK]
, NULL [BranchSK]
, TRE.[BankSK]
, DCA.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
, DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
, SUM([TotalRelationshipExposureFull]) AS TotalRelationshipExposureFull
, SUM([TotalRelationshipExposureProrated]) AS TotalRelationshipExposureProrated 
, DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
, 0 AS WorkFlowId
, 0 AS TaskRunId
, Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM TRE
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON TRE.AccountSK = DCA.AccountSK AND  DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DC ON  DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE DC.CUSTOMERSK IS NOT NULL
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'

GROUP BY 
 TRE.[BusinessDateSK]
,TRE.[BankSK]
,DCA.CustomerSK
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.SourceSystemCode
